notes.title: 241001 New Maintenance Schedule, Estimated Completion in 7 Days
notes.content:
[h3]New Game Maintenance Schedule
[/h3]
[list]
[*] From September 30, 1:00 AM to October 8, 1:00 AM (Pacific Time)
[*]* Corresponding to September 30, 4:00 PM to October 8, 4:00 PM (Hong Kong Time, PT+15)

[*] We sincerely apologize for adding 7 days to the originally scheduled maintenance period
[*] During this time, we will optimize graphics and address feedback from the Steam community. Thank you for your valuable suggestions!
[/list]

[h3]The Steam Community Provides Two Sections for Feedback
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Main Game Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2390660/discussions/
[*] Playtest Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2751740/discussions/
[/list]

[h3]Reiteration of Playtest Description
[/h3]
[list]
[*] This test serves as a pioneer for a larger scale test. We mainly focus on the following aspects:
[*] 1. Testing core processes: Confirming stability and baseline performance
[*] 2. Verifying "Time Zone Folding": Confirming the effectiveness of the new online service mode

[*] The "Test Description" is from the September 27th announcement: [MMORTS 2024 Battle for the Skies 2 Playtest Launch]
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2390660/view/4672011608155750234

Thank you sincerely!

notes.title: 240928 Fixed Notification 4: Black Screen and UI Issues
notes.content:
[Black Screen Issue]
1. Added a backup route to alleviate the black screen problem. Please try entering Relic-02 to see if it resolves the issue.
2. If both Relic-01 and Relic-02 experience freezing when entering a scene after character creation (loading bar at 100%), please wait patiently for our update. We will issue a fix notification once the situation is resolved.
3. We are actively monitoring all posts and replies in the Steam community. We read every single one. Thank you!

[UI Issues]
Fixed some known interface problems.

[Other]
The Steam community provides two sections for feedback:
1. Main Game Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2390660/discussions/

2. Playtest Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2751740/discussions/

notes.title: 20240928 Fix3
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the screen would turn black when the loading bar reached 100% during the first scene load after character selection
* Major fix implemented, involving data reset

notes.title: 20240928 Fix2
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the fog of war in the Fortress 44 scenario was constantly displaying as a black screen
Resolved an interface freeze occurring after opening the message board

notes.title: 20240928 Fix1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the screen would go black when the progress bar reached 100% during the first scene load after character selection.
* The fix was completed during the "Time Zone Folding" about 1 hour ago, involving a minor data reset.
* Subsequent "Time Zone Foldings" will continue to inherit previous game data according to the rules.

notes.title: 20240927 Fix2
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where mouse selection frame was not displaying in the battlefield environment
Fixed an intermittent issue where mouse tooltips were not showing
Resolved various pop-up window issues that were causing the game to freeze
Fixed an issue of excessive exposure in the character creation interface

notes.title: 20240927 Fix1
notes.content: Fixed the issue of getting stuck when first entering the game: Added a rotation mechanism to avoid congestion.
